user.title: BLE Positioning System
user.description: Set up BPS. Floor plans, zones and receivers are configured in the BPS panel in the sidebar.

data.show_sidebar_panel: Show the BPS panel in the sidebar

suggestion_answer.name: Answer suggestion
suggestion_answer.description: Answer the open BPS suggestion (sensor.bps_suggestion). The person is the user who calls it, e.g. by pressing a dashboard button.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: yes runs it, no skips it this time, never stops asking, undo reverts the last automatic run.

person.name: Person
person.description: Answer on behalf of this person (for automations). Leave empty to use the calling user.

follow_me_start.name: Start follow me
follow_me_start.description: Music starts following the person who calls it (e.g. by pressing a dashboard button) from room to room. Needs Follow me on in BPS Settings.

person.name: Person
person.description: Start it for this person (for automations). Leave empty to use the calling user.

follow_me_stop.name: Stop follow me
follow_me_stop.description: Music stops following the person who calls it.

person.name: Person
person.description: Stop it for this person (for automations). Leave empty to use the calling user.

suggest.name: Suggest
suggest.description: Ask the people BPS sees in a zone whether to run an action (notification with Yes / No / Don't ask again, plus sensor.bps_suggestion for a dashboard card). BPS learns per person; 3 yes in a row and it runs automatically next time, with an Undo button.

id.name: ID
id.description: Stable key for this suggestion; answers are learned per ID.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: BPS zone whose people are asked.

action.name: Action
action.description: Script, scene or automation to run on yes.

unknown_message.name: Question when only unidentified people are in the zone
unknown_message.description: When room sensors see someone without a tracker (kids, guests), ask the people at home with this text instead. Never runs automatically.

undo_entities.name: Undo entities
undo_entities.description: Snapshot these before running, so Undo can restore them.

once_per.name: At most once per
once_per.description: evening (resets at noon), day, hour or none.

suggestion_clear.name: Clear suggestion
suggestion_clear.description: The moment has passed (e.g. the TV went off); remove the open question.

suggestion_reask.name: Ask again
suggestion_reask.description: Forget that a suggestion was already asked in this period (for testing).
